newsitem.title: UK: Gen Accident sells New Zealand Life to Prudential.
newsitem.headline: Gen Accident sells New Zealand Life to Prudential.

text.p: British insurance group General Accident Plc said on Wednesday it had sold its New Zealand life company The New Zealand Insurance Life Limited to Prudential Corporation Plc for NZ$ 163.3 million.
General Accident said the sale was part of its strategy to concentrate its life and pensions business in Britain. It said it would continue to build up its general insurance business in New Zealand.
The company said New Zealand Insurance Life was owned 51 percent by General Accident and 49 percent by General Accident Life Assurance Limited Policyholder's Fund.

In a separate statement, Prudential Corporation said the acquisition would enable it to consolidate its position as New Zealand's leading writer of regular premium business and would double funds under management to just over 1.0 billion stg.
